exposure: Routine use of magnetic resonance venography (MRV)
outcome: Diagnostic identification of cerebral sinovenous thrombosis (CSVT)
cohort: The study included 291 term-born infants who received therapeutic hypothermia for neonatal encephalopathy between January 2014 and March 2020.
finding: Cerebral sinovenous thrombosis (CSVT) is uncommon in infants receiving therapeutic hypothermia for neonatal encephalopathy, and the routine inclusion of MRV in the post-rewarming imaging protocol was not associated with increased detection of CSVT.
